Commission history retention is implicit (no cascade delete) — verified by inspecting GET /admin/contractors after demote (list size goes from 2→1, the demoted user simply disappears from contractor-only filter).

Suggest auto-accepting consent for authenticated admin sessions OR document the workaround in /app/auth_testing.md (already documented in test_credentials.md).
AdminContractorProfilePage is reasonably-sized and well-structured; no large refactor needed.
